purpose: Matched-quiescent A/B (caches-FULL arm) plus a COMPLETE, saturation-graded GC refutation, captured on the longest-lived boot in this ticket history. Every surface here is PERISHABLE (resident rings die with the process; 3 boots died inside 18 minutes on 2026-09-23), so it is pinned to the repo in the same beat it was read.

boot.rthHoursNote: one session: Friday 2026-09-25 13:30-20:00Z. Born 04:13:12Z = 9h17m pre-open. Saturday 09-26 and Sunday 09-27 carry ZERO RTH-hours.

quiescentRing.note: The resident census ring is 288 slots at 300000ms = 24.0h capacity and is SATURATED (288/288), so it spans 2026-09-26T22:18:28Z -> 2026-09-27T22:13:28Z: 23.92 hours in which the market was closed for the entire span. This is the CACHES-FULL arm of the matched-quiescent A/B.
quiescentRing.containerNote: Per-sample counts are summarised as first/last/min/max per container, which is a COMPLETE test of the release claim (min==max means the container neither released nor grew across the whole span). Any container that DID move carries its full per-sample series verbatim.

ab.design: Two zero-activity reads, one variable: are the four session caches EMPTY or FULL. Confound stated: the arms are on DIFFERENT boots and DIFFERENT commits (EMPTY d26f58b994d8, FULL 66a8a1ab40cc). Same code path, same quiescent condition.

emptyArm.source: 2026-09-24 boot 02:21:01.359Z, pre-open 03:00-13:25Z, n=125, 10.4h, four session caches all 0

ab.corroboration: The 2026-09-24 in-session series measured 573.9MB retained over 6.50 RTH-h on ONE boot. This A/B puts the matched-quiescent retention at 531.0MB on a DIFFERENT boot and commit. Two independent estimators, 7.5 percent apart.

gcRefutation.claim: Over a COMPLETE 66.0h boot carrying one full RTH session, not one of the 28 loop blocks >=1000ms is coincident with any GC pause >=100ms, and the worst block is 11.2x the largest GC pause of ANY kind on the entire boot.

highLagRing.saturationNote: UNSATURATED at 28/32, so this is a TRUE CENSUS of every >=1000ms window this boot, not a lower bound. That missing grade is exactly what withdrew the 2026-09-24 n=21 claim; it is graded here.
highLagRing.allInsideOneSession: every one of the 28 lands inside Friday 2026-09-25 14:08:39Z-19:57:59Z; ZERO in the 50 quiescent hours since

gcRecentRing.saturationNote: UNSATURATED at 24/32, so these are EVERY GC pause >=100ms on the whole boot.

gcRefutation.coincidenceWindow: [atMs - sampleMs(1000) - lagMaxMs, atMs] -- widening can only turn a non-coincidence INTO a coincidence, so a zero here is conservative.
gcRefutation.positiveControl: a synthetic high-lag window placed 500ms after a real recorded GC IS scored coincident (verified in-beat)
gcRefutation.pauseDoesNotScaleWithHeap: largest pause landed at heap 790MB, not at the boot peak

lastTrip.note: trip #17, a HEAP trip on a PRIOR boot (2026-09-23T19:21:13Z). This boot has not tripped in 66.0h.

heapCapUnits.note: AC3 must be stated in MiB: --max-old-space-size 1536 + 3 x --max-semi-space-size 64 = 1728 MiB exactly.
